name: Lyo.Audit.Postgres
tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of Lyo.Audit using Entity Framework Core. Persists `AuditChange` and `AuditEvent` records to PostgreSQL with JSONB columns for dictionary data.
description: PostgreSQL implementation of Lyo.Audit using Entity Framework Core. Persists `AuditChange` and `AuditEvent` records to PostgreSQL with JSONB columns for dictionary data.
features: **Migrations.** EF Core migrations in the `audit` schema (`PostgresAuditOptions.Schema`) with `audit_changes` and `audit_events` tables.
**Auto migrations.** Optional automatic migration on startup via `EnableAutoMigrations`.

examples.title: Migrations
examples.code:
export AUDIT_CONNECTION_STRING="Host=localhost;Database=audit;Username=postgres;Password=postgres"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName --project Core/Audit/Lyo.Audit.Postgres

sections.title: Registration
rows: Binds `PostgresAuditOptions` from `"PostgresAudit"` (override section via the optional `configSectionName`) and registers as above.
Builds options from a raw connection string, registers the factory, and exposes a scoped `AuditDbContext`.
Uses a caller-provided `DbContextOptionsBuilder` (useful for tests or shared connection multiplexing).
Calls `AddAuditDbContextFactory` and registers `IAuditRecorder` → `PostgresAuditRecorder` as a singleton.
Same as the options overload, binding from configuration.

sections.title: Quick start
sections.text: Need just the factory, for example to share with downstream services or run migrations explicitly?

sections.title: Health
sections.text: `PostgresAuditRecorder` implements `Lyo.Health.IHealth` with `HealthCheckName = "audit-postgres"`. The probe opens an `AuditDbContext` and runs `Database.CanConnectAsync`. Connection failures return `HealthResult.Unhealthy`. Hosts that resolve `IEnumerable<IHealth>` include this recorder.
